title: Nightwork Layer 2 Standards Rule
description: Schema for a single industry-standards verification rule. One rule = one JSON file in .planning/verification/standards/<domain>/. The verifyFn referenced by string ID is resolved at runtime via src/lib/verification/registry.ts. Adding a new rule = drop a JSON file + register one function. Per D-02 forward-extensibility contract.

id.description: Globally unique rule ID. Convention: <domain>-<noun>-<test>. Example: conservation-money-line-items-sum.

domain.description: Standards domain. New domains require a CONTEXT.md addition + plan-review approval. The 'integrity' domain was added in F1-Wave-B Plan B-1b (nwrp152) for structural-invariant standards (audit conservation, RLS coverage, role-permission integrity, fixture coverage); these complement the 'conservation' domain (money-flow invariants) per umbrella Q9 D + Q11 D.

description.description: Detailed description including the math/identity/regulation being verified. Cite the source canonical (GAAP, AIA G702 row 7, FL statute 713.20(2)(a), etc.).

verifyFn.description: String ID of the registered verifyFn. Must match a key in src/lib/verification/registry.ts verifyFnRegistry. Convention: camelCase derived from rule id (e.g. conservation-money-line-items-sum -> conservationMoneyLineItemsSum).

items.description: Entity name this rule verifies. Examples: invoice, draw, change_order, lien_release, purchase_order.

applies_to.description: Entities this rule applies to. Layer 2 framework only invokes the rule when the relevant entity is in scope.

severity.description: blocking = halt the loop on FAIL; warning = report but continue.

source.description: Source citations. At least one. Examples: 'GAAP — basic accounting identity', 'AIA G702 row 7', 'Florida statute 713.20(2)(a)'.

tags.description: Free-form tags for filtering. Examples: money, conservation, line-items, retainage, draws.

examples.title: Line items must sum to total amount
examples.description: Sum of invoice.line_items[*].amount must equal invoice.total_amount within 1 cent tolerance. Basic accounting identity.
